Use case: compositing.
Asset type: polished website portfolio project cover, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: create a premium Numi product presentation from the THREE supplied real iPhone screens, with three large overlapping and staggered devices; the primary home-screen iPhone in the center is the largest and in front. Let the side phones peek out to left and right with minimal overlap of meaningful UI.
Input images: Image 1 (device-home.webp) is supporting compositing input for the center iPhone; image 2 (device-meal.webp, screen titled This Week) is supporting compositing input for the left iPhone; image 3 (device-progress.webp) is supporting compositing input for the right iPhone. Image 4 is ONLY a style reference for clean layered screen-collage polish; do not copy its screen content, cursor or toast.
Scene/backdrop: rich midnight plum and raspberry gradient with one subtle warm amber glow reflecting the Numi UI, with low-contrast depth. Full-bleed background. No scene props.
Composition: centered balanced trio taking up most of the canvas, roughly 82% of canvas height, each entire iPhone inside canvas with natural padding. Center phone front-on, side phones near-front-on and only very slightly angled. Small elegant stagger, realistic subtle soft shadows, restrained slim metal edges. Keep proportions of the original iPhones.
Constraints: Use the exact real screen pixels as faithfully as possible, preserve recognizable text, numbers, icons, graphs, food photos and UI layout unchanged. Do not redesign or invent screen content. Do not add any text outside the screens. No external brand label, no headline, no captions, no view-project text, no cursor circle, no browser chrome, no Codex toast, no watermark. Reproduce only the three Numi screens on phones against the new background.
